address: 14F, Eastin Grand Sathorn 33/1 Sathon Tai Road, Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok, 10120, Thailand
bio: Located on the 14th floor of Eastin Grand Sathorn, Chef Amerigo Sesti’s restaurant-bar offers a creative take on Northern Italian classics from his childhood, complemented by stunning city views. The stylish dining room features pop art and cosy seating. Try the handmade Italian pasta or tiramisu, showcasing the chef’s flair for authentic flavours. A DJ sets the mood from Thursday to Sunday nights....
